title: Chlorine, chromium and copper in boxes
caption: Chlorine follows the filling order. Chromium and copper do not: one 4s electron moves into 3d to give a half-filled 3d⁵ or a full 3d¹⁰, so chromium is [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹ and copper is [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹.
alt: Orbital box diagrams of the outer sub-shells: chlorine 3s² 3p⁵; chromium 3d⁵ 4s¹ with five single 3d electrons; copper 3d¹⁰ 4s¹.
description: Chlorine, [Ne] 3s² 3p⁵: 3s paired, 3p with two pairs and one single electron.
Chromium, [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹: five single 3d electrons, all spin up, and one 4s electron.
Copper, [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹: five paired 3d orbitals and one 4s electron.
